pages.title: Templates
pages._note: Decomposed to type:index (Phase 8): the template schema is OR-registered, so CnIndexPage lists the template objects directly. The bespoke lock/unlock/editor lives on TemplateDetail. `register` MUST be a register SLUG from lib/Settings/filinq_register.json — it was `filinq` from Phase 8 until 2026-08-03, a register Filinq has never shipped (the definition has declared `templates` since before Phase 8 landed), so this page listed a register that holds nothing while TemplatesController wrote to the `templates` register resolved from app config `template_register`.

pages.title: Template Detail
pages._note: Template detail view with lock/unlock, editor, and preview. Hybrid data path via templateStore.

pages.title: Guided document wizard
pages._note: The guided document wizard of a template (guided-document-wizard): one question per step with skip logic, a review step, then one call to api/documents/generate, which checks the answers again. type:custom because it reads the wizard through api/templates/{id}/wizard and prefills through api/wizards/{id}/prefill, filinq endpoints rather than object operations.

pages.title: Letters & correspondence
pages._note: Letter/correspondence generation from templates with merge data (single or batch), via correspondenceStore + CorrespondenceController (generate/generateBatch/jobStatus). Hybrid data path; type:custom preserves it. Restored reachability — openspec/changes/orphaned-surface-restoration (REQ-DDOSR-003); the component and backend already existed, only the manifest/registry/menu wiring was missing.

pages.title: Print Preview
pages._note: Standalone print-preview page; no nav item; launched programmatically.
